name: taskboard-idle-inbox
description: While the session is idle, checks Taskboard's inbox for the runs this session started or claimed and wakes the agent only when something new is waiting.

minIntervalSeconds.title: First check after idle (seconds)
minIntervalSeconds.description: Wait after a turn ends before the first inbox check; also the interval right after new items arrive.

maxIntervalSeconds.title: Longest interval (seconds)
maxIntervalSeconds.description: The interval doubles while nothing changes, up to this.
